$comment: Freezes finding #14 (nodalmerge-studio/plans/blob-cas-remediation.md, Phase 0 slice 0.4): the studio C# WorkUnitStatus enum's ordinals and PascalCase JSON casing, previously hand-mirrored (unpinned by any vector) by nodalmerge's Rust GC live-hash classifier. Consumed by: server/server/src/studio_live_hashes.rs's own #[cfg(test)] mod tests (Rust — inline vector tests reusing the real WorkUnitPayloadRaw deserializer and is_terminal_status/TERMINAL_STATUSES logic directly, no external tests/ crate or pub test-only surface; mirrors the blob_layout_vectors_match_s3_key_derivation precedent in server/s3-blobs/src/lib.rs) and nodalmerge-studio/tests/NodalMerge.Studio.Contracts.Tests/WorkUnitStatusVectorTests.cs (.NET, against nodalmerge-studio/src/NodalMerge.Studio.Contracts/Domain/WorkUnit.cs's WorkUnitStatus enum and WorkUnit record, serialized with bare JsonSerializer.Serialize(entity) as IStudioNodeStore's real write path does — no naming policy, no JsonStringEnumConverter). If you reorder/rename/insert a WorkUnitStatus value, this file and BOTH harnesses must move together: a silent drift here means nodalmerge's GC coordinator (server/server/src/studio_live_hashes.rs) misclassifies live work-unit-seeded snapshots as garbage and deletes them in production, instead of failing a test.
terminal_status_names_comment: Per studio_live_hashes.rs's STATUS_COMPLETED/STATUS_MERGED consts and its doc comment: Cancelled/DeadLettered have live revival edges (WorkUnitTransitions.CanTransition) and are deliberately NOT terminal here, unlike a narrower cache-eviction terminal set elsewhere in studio. `Failed` was removed from this list by slice 1.6 (finding #30, blob-cas-remediation.md): it also has a live revival edge (`Failed -> Cancelled -> Queued`/`Executing` via WorkUnit.cs's `(_, Cancelled) when from is not Completed and not Merged` rule), so a Failed work unit's seed must not be retention-aged either. This list is the GC-relevant terminal set only.

work_unit_envelope_vectors.description: the smallest real envelope the Rust classifier receives for a fresh work unit: optional fields absent (null), non-terminal status
queue-driven pipeline status (Phase 4 slice 11a) with RepositoryId populated, no Metadata
a terminal status (protects the retention classifier's Pinned/Active/Intermediate rules) with a populated Metadata map

regression pin for slice 1.6 (finding #30, blob-cas-remediation.md): Failed has a live revival edge (Failed -> Cancelled -> Queued/Executing via WorkUnit.cs's `(_, Cancelled) when from is not Completed and not Merged` rule), so the GC classifier must NOT treat it as terminal — a Failed work unit's seed snapshot must not be retention-aged out, since a human may return to steer or hand-fix it

regression pin for the deliberately-non-terminal DeadLettered case (studio_live_hashes.rs doc comment): despite sounding like an end state, DeadLettered has a live revival edge back to Retrying/Proposed/Merged/Queued/Executing, so the GC classifier must NOT treat it as terminal

delegate_room_id_placeholder.$comment: DECIDED by slice 7.4 (2026-07-17, blob-cas-remediation.md): on the room-agnostic blob HTTP routes (GET /blobs/{hash}/url, POST /blobs/{hash}/uploaded) every host passes room="_global" into the delegate presign protocol v1 (docs/BLOB_STORAGE_LAYOUT.md §7 — room is metadata-only, never a key input). "_global" won over the .NET host's previous "default": it reads as an intentional placeholder, it already matched the Rust host AND room.rs's GC-preflight placeholder, and "default" collides with a plausible real room id. `namespace` is frozen at "blobs" for hosts that send the protocol's OPTIONAL namespace field at all (.NET does); the Rust delegate client's request struct has no namespace field and continues to omit it — omission remains conformant, but a host that sends the field on these routes MUST send "blobs". Asserted by server/server/tests/blob_url_resolution_vectors.rs (capturing-backend room pin) and hosts/dotnet/tests/NodalMerge.DotNetHost.Tests/DelegateRoomPlaceholderVectorTests.cs (room + namespace pin). ⚠ This changed the .NET host's emitted metadata (room "default" -> "_global") — see the §7 note in docs/BLOB_STORAGE_LAYOUT.md.
